description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM door glass for the RH Side plus the attachment seals and metal frame to attach the glass to the regulator.
With the new Rubber glass seal and metal glass frame installing this is a breeze.
Without these pieces you’re in for a long day.
*The picture shows a LH glass but you will receive a new RH glass.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Glass – RH Side (Passengers Side) (New and Scratch FREE)
Qty 2 – Rubber Glass Seals
Qty 1 – Glass Frame
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
